en: Colorized vintage street scene showing a narrow European street lined with multi‑story buildings with green shutters. A tall brick tower rises in the background. Pedestrians and a horse‑drawn carriage move along the cobbled street. At the top of the image in red text it reads "866 — Trento Via Santa Maria Maggiore" indicating the location. Various shop signs hang from the buildings.
